summary: Frontend-only verification of two bug fixes: (1) Jelly Jukebox miss counter and (2) Shred City front-row crowd duplicate avatar. Both fixes verified end-to-end via Playwright on the live preview URL.

verified_fixes.bug: Jelly Jukebox results always showed 0 misses
verified_fixes.verification: Started /#/rhythm-game, Turbo speed, selected JMA 'Play One Skip One' and did NOT tap any bell for the entire song. Results screen (data-testid=rhythm-results) showed Hit=0, Miss=50, Streak=0x => misses correctly accumulate via FallingBellNote onAnimationComplete -> handleNoteMiss. Accuracy effectively 0% (< 100%).
verified_fixes.regression_check: Monitored concurrent falling-note DOM nodes under .rhythm-lanes while NOT tapping; max concurrent was 9 and the count oscillated (never monotonically grew), confirming notes are removed from the DOM once they reach the bottom and are not left as ever-growing ghosts.

verified_fixes.bug: Shred City front row duplicated the kid's avatar character (e.g. two Jazzys)
verified_fixes.verification:
Set localStorage jma_avatar_v1 for 3 cases and opened /#/shred-legend, picked song 0 (Garage Stomp). Collected img srcs of the 7 front-row sprites (data-testid=shred-crowd-row, data-back-row='false') and computed character prefixes using the same rule as charOf (sharky|shark|finn => finn, dr-jellybone => jellybone).
  - jazzy/classic: front row = finn, chunk, charlie, jazzy(YOU), lou, stew, jellybone. No duplicates, exactly one jazzy, YOU tag present.
  - charlie/classic: front row = finn, chunk, jazzy, charlie(YOU), lou, stew, jellybone. No duplicates.
  - finn/plain (uses shark.png): front row = chunk, jazzy, charlie(-punk), shark(YOU=finn), lou, stew, jellybone. No duplicates when collapsed by character prefix; exactly one 'finn' member and it is the YOU sprite.

action_items: Low priority: React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' fires repeatedly on both /#/rhythm-game (during play) and /#/shred-legend (during play). Not blocking; likely stems from an AnimatePresence child list reusing an index/burstId as key (e.g. CrowdMember uses key={i} while motion.div inside also uses key={burstId}, or floats/shouts arrays). Worth auditing to silence the console.
critical_code_review_comments: RhythmGamePage.js is ~990 lines - above the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the FallingBellNote and the menu/finished/playing screens into separate files.
ShredLegendPage.js is ~886 lines - similar split opportunity (CrowdRow / StageLights / CameraFlashes could live in their own module).
React warning about duplicate keys inside AnimatePresence appears on both pages during gameplay (see action_items).
seed_data_creation: localStorage keys set per test: jma_unlock_all_v1='1', jma_reveal_seen_v1='1', jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1', jma_player_v1={name:'Test'}, jma_audio_unlocked_v1='1', jma_avatar_v1 set per case.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On this preview, the AudioUnlockOverlay still appears on every load even with jma_audio_unlocked_v1='1' (it only hides after a real pointer click). Dismiss it with: await page.query_selector('[data-testid="audio-unlock-overlay"]').click() BEFORE trying to click [data-testid="player-name-skip"] - otherwise the name prompt's skip button is intercepted by the overlay. Vimeo 401s in the sandbox are expected. HashRouter is used so routes are /#/...
